##Read the datasets and questionaires of the HPFS main questionaires
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

read_hp_dataset <- function(year_code) {
  
  # Determine Base Filenames
  suffix_years <- c("86", "88", "90", "94", "98")
  if (year_code %in% suffix_years) {
    base_name <- paste0("hp", year_code, "a")
  } else {
    base_name <- paste0("hp", year_code)
  }
  
  if (year_code == "88") {
    data_filename <- "hp88.jan2"
  } else if (year_code == "87") {
    data_filename <- "hp87.jan2"
  } else {
    data_filename <- base_name
  }
  
  # Find the Dictionary
  possible_dicts <- c(
    paste0(base_name, ".sas.dd"),
    paste0(base_name, ".dd"),
    paste0("hp", year_code, ".sas.dd") 
  )
  
  dd_path <- NULL
  for (f in possible_dicts) {
    full_path <- paste0("/n/hpnh/ReadMacros/HPFS/dd/", f)
    if (file.exists(full_path)) {
      dd_path <- full_path
      break
    }
  }
  
  # Find Data File
  data_path <- paste0("/n/hpnh/HPFS/Qdata/hp_dat_qqf/", data_filename)
  
  if (is.null(dd_path)) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", year_code, "- No dictionary found."))
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
    warning(paste("Skipping", year_code, "- Data file not found:", data_path))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Parse Dictionary
  lines <- readLines(dd_path)
  regex_pattern <- "^\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_\\.]+)\\s+([A-Za-z]+)\\s*(\\d+)(.*)"
  matches <- str_match(lines, regex_pattern)
  
  vars_df <- data.frame(
    Variable   = matches[, 2],
    Type       = matches[, 3],
    Length     = as.numeric(matches[, 4]),
    RestOfLine = trimws(matches[, 5]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(Variable))
  
  # Intelligently extract Start Positions & Remove Overlays
  vars_df <- vars_df %>%
    mutate(
      first_token = str_extract(RestOfLine, "^\\S+"),
      # Identify if the token is an overlay pointer (starts with @)
      is_overlay = grepl("^@", first_token),
      # It is a start position ONLY if it's numbers/hyphens AND doesn't contain a ")"
      is_start_pos = grepl("^\\d+(-?\\d+)?$", first_token) & !grepl("\\)", first_token),
      # Extract the first number if it's a valid position
      Start = if_else(is_start_pos, as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", first_token)), NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    # CRITICAL FIX: Remove the SAS overlay variables so they don't break the sequence
    filter(!is_overlay)
  
  # Sequentially impute missing Start positions (Exactly how SAS does it)
  current_pointer <- 1
  for (i in 1:nrow(vars_df)) {
    if (!is.na(vars_df$Start[i])) {
      # If explicit start is given, jump the pointer there (e.g., id at 41)
      current_pointer <- vars_df$Start[i]
    } else {
      # If no start is given, start exactly where the last variable ended
      vars_df$Start[i] <- current_pointer
    }
    # Advance the pointer by the length of the current variable
    current_pointer <- vars_df$Start[i] + vars_df$Length[i]
  }

  # Finalize Variable DataFrame
  vars_df <- vars_df %>%
    mutate(End = Start + Length - 1) %>%
    distinct(Variable, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(Variable, Length, Start, End)
  
  # Safety Check: Ensure 'id' is captured correctly
  if (!any(vars_df$Variable == "id")) {
    vars_df <- bind_rows(
      data.frame(Variable = "id", Length = 6, Start = 41, End = 46),
      vars_df
    ) %>% arrange(Start) %>% distinct(Variable, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Read Data
  print(paste("Reading:", year_code, "| Dict:", basename(dd_path), "| Vars:", nrow(vars_df)))
  
  tryCatch({
    read_fwf(
      file = data_path,
      col_positions = fwf_positions(
        start = vars_df$Start,
        end   = vars_df$End,
        col_names = vars_df$Variable
      ),
      col_types = cols(.default = col_double()), 
      trim_ws = TRUE,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Failed to read", base_name, ":", e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Execution: Re-read the data lists
all_years <- c("86", "87", "88", "90", "92", "94", "96", "98", 
               sprintf("%02d", seq(0, 22, 2)))

hp_data_list <- lapply(all_years, read_hp_dataset)
names(hp_data_list) <- paste0("hp", all_years)

```

```{r}

################read the dictionaries################
# 1. Define the Function
get_hp_dictionary <- function(year_code) {
  
  # Determine base names
  suffix_years <- c("86", "88", "90", "94", "98")
  if (year_code %in% suffix_years) {
    base_name <- paste0("hp", year_code, "a")
  } else {
    base_name <- paste0("hp", year_code)
  }
  
  # Search for Dictionary (Checking all naming variations)
  possible_dicts <- c(
    paste0(base_name, ".sas.dd"), 
    paste0(base_name, ".dd"),
    paste0("hp", year_code, ".sas.dd")
  )
  
  dd_path <- NULL
  for (f in possible_dicts) {
    full_path <- paste0("/n/hpnh/ReadMacros/HPFS/dd/", f)
    if (file.exists(full_path)) {
      dd_path <- full_path
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(dd_path)) {
    warning(paste("No dictionary found for year:", year_code))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Parse Text
  lines <- readLines(dd_path)
  
  # Regex handles: Name -> Type -> Length -> Start -> Optional Range -> Optional Label
  # Matches "id i6 41" AND "id i6 41-46"
  regex_pattern <- "^\\s*([A-Za-z0-9_\\.]+)\\s+([A-Za-z]+)\\s*(\\d+)\\s+(\\d+)(?:-\\d+)?(?:\\s+(.*))?$"
  
  matches <- str_match(lines, regex_pattern)
  
  # Create Table
  dict_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = matches[, 2],
    Label    = matches[, 6],
    Start    = as.numeric(matches[, 5]),
    Length   = as.numeric(matches[, 4]),
    Type     = matches[, 3]
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Variable)) %>%
    arrange(Start) %>%
    select(Variable, Label, Start, Length, Type)
  
  return(dict_df)
}

# 2. Initialize the List (This fixes your error!)
hp_dicts <- list()

# 3. Load All Years (including 87)
all_years <- c("86", "87", "88", "90", "92", "94", "96", "98", 
               sprintf("%02d", seq(0, 22, 2)))

print("Loading all dictionaries...")
hp_dicts <- lapply(all_years, get_hp_dictionary)
names(hp_dicts) <- paste0("hp", all_years)
```

#look at the prevalence of diseases across waves

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1. Create a reference table (Map) of variable names per year
disease_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Disease_Label,          ~hp88,     ~hp00,     ~hp12,     ~hp20,
  "Stroke",                "str88",   "strk00",  "strk12",  "strk20",
  "Carotid Surgery",       NA,        "cart00",  "cart12",  "cart20",
  "Angina",                "ang88",   "ang00",   "ang12",   "ang20",
  "Angina Confirmed",      "angc88",  "angc00",  "angc12",  "angc20",
  "CABG",                  "cabg88",  "cabg00",  "cabg12",  "cabg20",
  "MI (Heart Attack)",     "mi88",    "mi00",    "mi12",    "mi20",
  "Claudication",          "clau88",  "clau00",  "clau12",  NA,       # Missing in 2020 col in image
  "Pulmonary Embolism",    "pe88",    "pe00",    "pe12",    "pulm20", # Name change in 2020
  "High Blood Pressure",   "hbp88",   "hbp00",   "hbp12",   "hbp20",
  "Cholesterol",           "chol88",  "chol00",  "chol12",  "chol20",
  "Diabetes",              "db88",    "db00",    "db12",    "db20",
  "Gout",                  "gout88",  "gout00",  "gout12",  "gout20",
  "Hip Fracture",          "hfra88",  "hfra00",  "hipf12",  "hipf20", # Name change in 12/20
  "Osteoarthritis",        "oa88",    "oa00",    "oa12",    "arth20", # Name change in 2020
  "Osteoporosis",          "ost88",   "ost00",   "ost12",   "ost20",
  "Colon Polyps",          "cpol88",  "cpol00",  "cpol12",  "cpol20",
  "Ulcer",                 "ulc88",   "gdul00",  "gdul12",  "gdul20", # Name change
  "Parkinsons",            "park88",  "park00",  "park12",  "park20",
  "Glaucoma",              "glau88",  "glau00",  "glau12",  "glau20",
  "Macular Degen",         "macu88",  "macu00",  "macu12",  "macu20"
)

# 2. Function to calculate prevalence for a single variable in a single dataset
get_prevalence <- function(dataset, var_name) {
  # If variable doesn't exist or is NA in our map, return NA
  if (is.na(var_name) || !var_name %in% names(dataset)) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # Calculate % of people marked as "1" (ignoring NAs in the count of 1s)
  # divided by the TOTAL number of people in the dataset
  total_people <- nrow(dataset)
  count_yes <- sum(dataset[[var_name]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(round((count_yes / total_people) * 100, 2))
}

# 3. Build the comparison table
results <- disease_map %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Prev_1988 = get_prevalence(hp_data_list$hp88, hp88),
    Prev_2000 = get_prevalence(hp_data_list$hp00, hp00),
    Prev_2012 = get_prevalence(hp_data_list$hp12, hp12),
    Prev_2020 = get_prevalence(hp_data_list$hp20, hp20)
  ) %>%
  select(Disease_Label, Prev_1988, Prev_2000, Prev_2012, Prev_2020)

# 4. View the final comparison
print(results, n = 30)
```
